name: BUNN reflection deliver() inflates the pair's balance inside a flash swap
summary: BUNN is a reflection token whose public deliver() burns the caller's reflections and raises every non-excluded holder's balance, including its BUNN/WBNB pair's. Twice in one transaction the attacker flash-swapped WBNB and 1e12 BUNN units out of the pair and, inside the callback, delivered 99% of that BUNN, which lifted the pair's BUNN balance enough to pass the K check, keeping 52 WBNB.
notes: The owner's later changes (fees set to zero, a second excludeFromReward) neither added deliver() nor excluded the pair; the deployment is the reset.

Campaign: every swap on the BUNN/WBNB pair paying out both tokens, scanned from pair creation to block 66000000; the anchor is the first, and seven copycats with the same 1e12-unit flash swap took 1.45 WBNB more. Loss is the pair's WBNB outflow; its BUNN is valued at nothing (rule 12).
